observations.body: The writer speaks of reminding hearers while present and after an imminent departure.
observations.label: Departure

observations.body: Majesty, honor, glory, voice, beloved Son, and holy mountain are offered against invented stories.
observations.label: Mountain memory

observations.body: Attention, lamp, dawn, interpretation, human will, and speech from God carry the paragraph forward.
observations.label: Prophetic word

payload.posture: Distinguish the letter’s self-presentation, remembered event, and account of prophecy.
payload.tension: A personal eyewitness memory is joined to a broader claim about prophetic speech rather than left as a private recollection.
payload.title: Eyewitnesses of his majesty
